newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Sodra says turning point for pulp at hand.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Sodra says turning point for pulp at hand.

text.p: Swedish forestry cooperative Sodra said on Tuesday the first quarter of 1997 was a turning point for the forestry industry, especially for pulp.
"The first quarter looks like it could be a turning point after a drawn-out depressed period for the forestry industry in general and especially for the pulp industry," Sodra said in a statement.
"Demand for our products is good and competition internationally has improved because of the strengthening of the dollar," Sodra said.

At the same time the company, which is not listed, posted a loss of 31 million crowns after financial items for the first three months of the year compared to a loss of 55 million crowns in the same period one year ago.
Sales rose to 1.69 billion crowns from 1.63 in the first three months of 1996.
